uplink.description: Status frame 0x01: three CT currents + phase A multiplier -> one channels entry per phase
uplink._note: Upstream-example input (TTN netvox r718nl3 codec yaml, Apache-2.0). Oracle fields from the ported netvox decoder: Current1 1000 mA, Current2 200 mA, Current3 7000 mA, Multiplier1 1, Volt 3.6. Per-phase mA/1000 -> power.current inside phaseA/phaseB/phaseC entries; only phase A's multiplier is carried by this frame variant.

uplink.description: Status frame 0x01 with a distinct current per clamp (multi-CT)
uplink._note: Synthetic in-bounds frame 0x01 giving each clamp a clearly distinct reading, so a per-position mix-up cannot pass: verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (Volt 3.6, Current1 1234 mA, Current2 56 mA, Current3 65535 mA — the 16-bit maximum — Multiplier1 5). Currents normalize to 1.234 / 0.056 / 65.535 A in the phaseA/phaseB/phaseC entries.

uplink.description: Status frame 0x02: phase B/C CT multipliers + whole-device illuminance
uplink._note: Upstream-example input (TTN netvox r718nl3 codec yaml, Apache-2.0). Oracle: Volt 3.6, Multiplier2 3, Multiplier3 10, Illuminance 2500 — no current fields. The single ambient light sensor is whole-device and stays top-level (air.lightIntensity); entries are emitted only for the phases the frame mentions, carrying just that phase's configuration extra.
